candidate_evidence.quote: To determine whether the combination of ipilimumab and nivolumab increases the tumor response rate assessed by modified Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology (RANO) Criteria in patients with hypermutated recurrent glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma (World Health Organization \[WHO\] grade IV) presenting at first or second recurrence including secondary glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive nivolumab IV over 30 minutes and ipilimumab IV over 30 minutes on day 1.

coder_notes: Eligible population includes both glioblastoma IDH-wildtype and astrocytoma IDH-mutant grade 4 (WHO 2021 cited) -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named, cns5. IDH status is a diagnostic definition (either allowed), not recorded as a selection biomarker. TMB >= 10 is a registration (entry) requirement and is matched to the checkpoint inhibitors on the record's stated rationale that hypermutated tumours may respond to immunotherapy. Exploratory PD-L1/immune infiltrate analysis is a correlative association with outcome rather than a target-modulation measurement -> target_engagement unclear. MRI is a procedure, not listed as an agent. Note: quotes containing escaped brackets/inequalities copy the record text literally (e.g. '\>=').
